title: Lichess: free Chess.com alternative
caption:
Chess.com charges $10.99/month to review your chess games. Lichess does it for free ♟️

✅ Play live games against anyone, or the computer
✅ Unlimited puzzles
✅ Free computer analysis to learn from your mistakes
✅ No ads, no tracking, no paywall, 100% free

💻 Any browser · iPhone · Android
ℹ️ Heads up: Chess.com's free plan gives you a taste, but full game analysis starts at Platinum ($10.99/month). Lichess is a non-profit run on donations

Comment "CHESS" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
